about: Report-only shore and access-land overlays for Kentucky state fishing lakes. Not a KY key outline. KPC_RESEARCH_SOURCES defaults to off, and the map switch that would draw these stays off, so nothing here changes a join, a pin, or the saved water outline.
source_label: county tax parcel, KDFWR owner, not a survey

robots.rule: no robots.txt (404): nothing is disallowed, so the parcel read was allowed

lakes.name: Beaver Lake State Fishing Lake
lakes.why: No KDFWR land polygon on an allowed layer. Anderson County PVA is qPublic only, which was not used.

lakes.name: Kingfisher Lakes State Fishing Lake
lakes.note: Two lakes, Old and New. Their water (PAD-US 202794) is unioned with the two Daviess pieces that touch that water. Not shared with Carpenter.
access: Old Kingfisher ramp ASID 147 (inside the 17.30 ac piece, with the park pin)
New Kingfisher ramp ASID 148 (inside the 22.79 ac piece)
lakes.published_acres: KDFWR publishes the pair as 21.2 ac and 13.8 ac. PAD-US measures Old at 14.30 ac and New at 19.45 ac.

lakes.name: Carpenters Lake State Fishing Lake
lakes.note: Separate from Kingfisher. Water (PAD-US 202790) unioned with the one Daviess piece that touches Carpenter.

lakes.name: Guist Creek Lake State Fishing Lake
lakes.padus_caution: Brandon: do not use the Guist PAD-US water outline without checking. This report does not replace or expand it.
lakes.why: The bank-access parcel is not already in the repo. Its service is services2.arcgis.com, and a robots 403 is a disallow, so it was not fetched.
